_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is tracked on purpose and must hold NON-SENSITIVE deployment values only. Anything that identifies a real person, address, mailbox or third party goes in config.local.json, which is gitignored and hand-provisioned per machine (see README). Any value can also be overridden by an env var: SKILLS_<DOTTED_KEY_UPPER>, e.g. SKILLS_DISCORD_CHANNELS_READING_LIST.

home._local: LOCAL — travel-time origin. Real address never committed.
home.label: Home

workspace._comment: Agent workspace directories under ~/.openclaw/workspace/. The anchor is hardcoded (CONVENTIONS.md 4); only the leaf is deployment. lib/skill_config.py work_root() reads this.

_sensitive: The keys below marked LOCAL live in config.local.json, never here. A fresh clone fails loudly on them until provisioned — that is deliberate; see lib/skill_config.py.

accounts._local: LOCAL — mailbox identities the skills authenticate as.

paths._local: LOCAL — the Drive mount name embeds a work account address.

jira._local: LOCAL — people maps PM aliases/emails to Atlassian account ids (third-party PII).

mail._local: LOCAL — himalaya alias -> real mailbox. Aliases are local himalaya config names, so they move with the addresses.

net._local: LOCAL — Tailscale MagicDNS host of the machine running the local servers.
